pr.title: test(rte): cost-profile redesign integration coverage (E9)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds 8 integration test files covering end-to-end flow per cost profile (value-default / economy / quality / experimental).
- Covers spend-ledger integration (effective cost matches expected after service_tier × cache × batch math), Anthropic cache_control passthrough via OR, batch-discount accounting, and legacy --routing-policy deprecation path.
- Adds three test fixtures (minimal v3 yaml, v3 yaml with all 6 overrides, minimal pricing yaml) so tests don't depend on the real promptsets/v4/model_map.yaml.

## Scope
Test-only. No production code changes. If a test reveals a bug, a follow-up TP fixes it.

## Validation
All 8 new integration test files pass under RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1. Existing cost_profiles + spend_ledger_optimizers + pricing_catalog + spend_ledger suites remain green.

## NOT_RUN
- Live provider calls.
- F verification packet (post-merge bounded-lane dry run).

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- Mock-based integration testing can't catch provider-side behavior drift (e.g., OpenAI silently ignoring service_tier on a model that doesn't support it). F packet's bounded-lane dry run partially covers.

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight: verify E3, E4-FINISH, E7, E8 packets all merged. Verify worktree clean.
validation: All four preceding packets visible in ancestry.

steps.task: Write the three test fixtures under tests/fixtures/: minimal v3 yaml (4 cells, 4 step IDs across 4 profiles), v3 with all 6 overrides (covers Z0/C10/S12/T0/T1/T3 patterns), minimal pricing yaml (5 models with full optimizer fields).
validation: Each fixture has its own docstring header explaining what test scenarios it covers.

steps.task: Write test_cost_profile_e2e_value_default.py (10+ tests): full path CLI → cfg → call_llm → spend_ledger for value-default. Covers: cell resolution returns OR-routed primary for CE/medium and CE/high (Phase D consensus); cached_input pricing applied; flex tier on EXTRACT bulk lanes; standard tier on SYNTH; spend ledger total matches computed expected cost; PROOF_PACK records cost_profile.
validation: Each test asserts on an effective dollar amount (not just shape) to catch silent pricing drift.

steps.task: Write test_cost_profile_e2e_economy.py (8+ tests): economy = flex everywhere supported, cheap models, escalation_max_hops=1, max_cost_usd_default=$5.00; verify gpt-5.1-codex-mini on CE/medium primary; haiku 4.5 on SYNTH/high; sonnet 4.5 on SYNTH/critical; default cost cap applies if --max-cost-usd omitted.

Write test_cost_profile_e2e_quality.py (8+ tests): quality = priority tier on OpenAI, opus 4.6 primary on SYNTH/critical (not 4.7 — per Phase D consensus), escalation_max_hops=3, batch disabled, opus 4.7 only via cell_alias override; verify --model-alias QUALITY_SYNTH_CRITICAL_MODEL=anthropic/claude-opus-4.7 propagates.

Write test_cost_profile_e2e_experimental.py (6+ tests): experimental = bleed-edge frontier (gpt-5.5-pro, claude-opus-4.7, gemini-3.5-flash), max_cost_usd_default=$25.00, warning surfaced in cfg.cost_profile_notes.
validation: Warning string is asserted on so docs / cfg drift is caught.

steps.task: Write test_legacy_routing_policy_deprecation_e2e.py (8+ tests covering: every legacy policy name resolves to expected new cost profile per LEGACY_ROUTING_POLICY_TO_COST_PROFILE; deprecation warning emitted on use; --cost-profile wins when both set; warning message names the recommended new flag).

Write test_cost_profile_spend_ledger_integration.py (10+ tests covering: accumulate() with cached_input_tokens reduces final cost; service_tier=flex on accumulate applies multiplier; is_batch=True on accumulate applies discount; tier × cache stacking math matches compute_optimized_cost; preventive cap (make_projected_cost_check) blocks before the call; per-cell cache_hit_rate surfaces in spend_ledger.json).
validation: Effective $ values asserted to 4 decimal places.

steps.task: Write test_cost_profile_anthropic_cache_e2e.py (6+ tests): Anthropic via OR with cache_control markers — first call writes cache (priced at 1.25x or 2.0x input rate); subsequent call within 5min reads cache (priced at 0.1x input rate); cache discount surfaces in spend ledger; mocked Anthropic usage response with cache_read_input_tokens parsed correctly into cached_tokens meta field.
validation: First-call vs subsequent-call cost difference matches expected ratio (~10x reduction).

steps.task: Write test_cost_profile_batch_discount_e2e.py (5+ tests): batch route metadata triggers is_batch=True in spend_ledger; final cost 50% of standard; batch_multiplier surfaces in cost_breakdown; OpenRouter batch raises UnsupportedBatchProvider (regression of audit-confirmed behavior); xAI batch unverified flag warns operator.
Commit allowlisted files; push; open PR.
